description: 仲裁留痕一致性(实锤案例二)- 极简输入下槽位层(chat)与嵌入层(order_status)双分类跨族冲突,留痕 winner 必须与终局 intents[0] 同源(2026-09-10 工单01 仲裁留痕列)

assert.value: output => { const p = JSON.parse(output); const a = p.arbitration || {}; const winner = a.winner; const first = (p.intents || [])[0]?.intent; if (!a.method || !Array.isArray(a.candidates) || a.candidates.length === 0) { return { pass: false, score: 0, reason: `arbitration trace incomplete: method=${a.method}, candidates=${JSON.stringify(a.candidates)}` }; } if (winner !== first) { return { pass: false, score: 0, reason: `trace winner ${winner} !== terminal intents[0] ${first}` }; } return true; }
